mentions.name: Fungi Logging Diary
mentions.description: A logging diary for fungi foraging that lets users identify and record their findings in the field, designed to make it easy to log entries without phone signal.
mentions.problem: Logging fungi findings in the field is difficult without phone signal.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building something also related to the fungi world, but far less ambitious: a logging diary to identify and log findings so it's easy to log those findings without phone signal.

evidence.value: I am building something also related to the fungi world, but far less ambitious: a logging diary to identify and log findings so it's easy to log those findings without phone signal.
